actual: Formal preset_A coefficient generation for 2024-07-01..2026-08-28 on immutable R8-hotfix1 fails in load_frozen_coefficient_inputs because coefficient-window quote availability (starts 2024-07-01) is incorrectly enforced against the three-year causal burn-in history beginning 2021-06. Real 2021 quote rows are rejected as outside authority. The fix must preserve the full burn-in, enforce finite complete historical observations without fallback, use quote availability only for coefficient-date eligibility, and retain all existing 131/119/113/6, PIT membership, hash, no-fill and fail-closed semantics. No dataset changes, database fallback, model retraining, QE business changes, or service control.
